items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I joined Chick Webb's band, I went there that night, there was Freddie Jenkins

ctx.x: I did because that -- was one book I have, I think I have the book where there was -- an Esquire jazz book I think in the '30's, where they said Doc Cheatham the greatest first trumpet player in the world, and I didn't like that. Cause I didn't want to be called a first trumpet player. Benny Carter had a write-up somewhere, recently, a few years ago, that he said Doc Cheatham's the greatest first trumpet -- was, at that time, greatest trumpet player in the world. And I didn't like that I didn't want to be branded…

I joined Chick Webb's band, I went there that night, there was Freddie Jenkins, I don't know what other trumpet player but they all sat down and left the first trumpet chair open and nobody seated there. And the book, so naturally I went and sat, and played the lead.
